text:
maria: Quick sync — we should prune the role graph to stop the steady growth and reduce authz eval latency. Proposal: soft-deprecate unused roles for 30d, notify owners, then hard-prune after audit. Thoughts?

josh: Agree in principle. How do we define "unused"? last_grant_ts < 90d? also check api key and token usage logs.

maria: Detection plan: scan authz telemetry for (principal, role) tuples and role policy attachments. Candidate roles = no principals in 90d AND no attached policies. Mark them soft-deprecated with metadata: discovery_ts, reason, owner_hint.

kevin: Heads-up: automation/service accounts can rebind roles. We need an exemption label (e.g., role.metadata.system=automation) so we don't prune infra roles.

sanford: Also surface candidates in Console + CSV export and send email to owner hints before pruning. For migration we should allow mapping to replacement roles.

maria: Migration safety: maintain fallback mapping in authz service that rewrites pruned_role -> replacement_role for 60d. Example mapping snippet: ```{"from":"role:old-build","to":"role:ci:writer"}```. Fallback will log a warning and emit audit events.

ops-bot: Deploy job scheduled: authz-prune-scan @ 03:00 UTC daily — results -> #eng-security (automated scan only, no deletes). :mag:

josh: Rollout plan: canary on non-prod orgs for 14d, evaluate signal set (authz latency, errors, audit rejects), then prod-canary (5% orgs), then global.

maria: Agreed. Key signals: 95th authz latency, fallback-mapping hits, manual restore requests, and number of affected tokens. We'll keep soft-deletes for restore window.

kevin: Perf note — reducing roles affects token cache behavior. We'll invalidate caches incrementally: per-region, per-service, and monitor cache miss rate. Add a feature flag to gate hard prune.

sanford: Add retention/tombstone policy: tombstone table with role blob kept for 7d after hard prune; restore API (ops-only) to rehydrate role and reassign grants.

maria: Security/visibility: every prune action must create an immutable audit event with before/after role JSON and actor (system or user). We'll also capture heuristic that selected the role.

josh: Volunteers: I can own the runbook (canary checklist, rollback steps, communication).

kevin: I'll implement SDK mapping + cache invalidation hooks and the feature flag.

maria: I'll draft the RFC follow-up doc with query examples and post it tomorrow. For now, can we get at least one reviewer for the migration script? @josh @kevin

josh: I'll review the script after you post it.

ops-bot: Reminder: authz-prune-scan results will be published to the security audit S3 bucket: s3://redwood-authz-audit/prune-scans/8429991234.json

maria: Thanks — if anyone sees a nuance we missed (org-level policies, delegated roles), call it out here. Otherwise I'll start the soft-deprecate run next week behind the feature flag. :white_check_mark:
